subject.title: [Feature Request]: Session snapshots — save and load context checkpoints (/session save|load)

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class native session snapshot contract, and should v1 cover named save/load, branch-only recovery, archive import, or the broader checkpoint/replay engine?
rationale: The request spans persistent session state, destructive restore semantics, archive ownership, prompt-cache behavior, security/privacy, Gateway protocol, CLI/chat/UI UX, and overlap with several open session-state trackers; automation cannot safely choose that product/API shape.

options.title: Define native snapshot contract
options.body: Create a core Gateway/session-store design for named save/list/load/branch semantics and route chat, CLI, UI, docs, and tests through it.

options.title: Start with archive resume
options.body: Limit v1 to listing and resuming archived or prior sessions while leaving named reusable snapshots and deterministic replay to later work.

options.title: Fold into checkpoint engine
options.body: Defer this issue until the broader deterministic checkpoint, replay, and diff model in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/17211 is defined.

recommendation.title: Define native snapshot contract
recommendation.body: Create a core Gateway/session-store design for named save/list/load/branch semantics and route chat, CLI, UI, docs, and tests through it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete provided the live design-follow-up signal and has current-main history across the relevant session command/protocol surfaces.
